name: Enterprise API Attack Chain Assessment
description: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator layer for the enterprise cloud application penetration test. Covers a five-stage attack chain from unauthenticated reconnaissance to internal vault compromise.

techniques.comment: Stage 1: Active scanning for service discovery and port enumeration
Stage 1: Exploit GraphQL introspection to enumerate API schema
Stage 1: Unsecured debug tokens exposed in API responses
Stage 2: Valid OAuth session obtained via redirect_uri bypass
Stage 3: Mass assignment vulnerability enables privilege escalation to super-admin
Stage 3: Account manipulation via role field injection
Stage 4: Cloud metadata service discovered and accessed via SSRF
Stage 4: Cloud IAM credentials extracted from metadata endpoint
Stage 5: JWT token forged via algorithm confusion (RS256 to HS256)
Stage 5: Cryptographic trust subverted using RSA public key as HMAC secret
Stage 5: Internal vault secrets extracted including database and cloud credentials
